item.title: Run, hide, fight presentation replaces first ALICE training after Nov. 10 incident
item.description: EIU hosted an informational session on run, hide and fight procedures and Alert EIU updates on Tuesday evening in the Martin Luther King Jr. University Union. item.title: Panthers of the Week: Zion Fruster, Abby Venhaus
item.description: The male Panther of the Week is going to Zion Fruster from the men’s basketball team. item.title: University Food Court adds credit card fee
item.description: Students dining in the University Food Court will now find a 50 cent convenience fee added to their total if they pay with a credit card. Eastern’s merchant services provider charges a processing fee for payments made using credit cards. This convenience fee was previously paid for by the food court, according to Chris Coffey, the associate director of housing and dining for Panther Dining...

item.title: Cellist Joshua Romans touches on long COVID-19 struggles in ‘Immunity’
item.description: The Doudna Fine Arts Center hosted guest cellist Joshua Roman’s “Immunity” program on Saturday in the recital hall. Roman suffers from long-term COVID-19, causing him to experience several complications every day. Roman is no longer able to drive, both because of his treatment and because his body will at times shut down completely, rendering him unable to breathe or move, he said on stage.
